verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Mastra as a framework with agents, tools, workflows and a multi-mode harness, and only names 'Mastra Code' in passing. No evidence shows Mastra supervising or embedding a coding agent that clones repos, edits files, or runs tests. Generic tool and agent primitives are developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
